Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Over the years I have owned several gas grills that ended up in the trash because they did not perform and/or they rusted away. This is a quality product. I learned to respect it when I assembled it; the instructions, for the most part, were quite clear and easy to follow. While I was assembling the grill I noted that the parts were well-made and protected from weathering. One of the most impressive aspects of assembling the grill myself was unpacking the parts. Hats off to the genius that came up with the packaging for the grill. If there are any complaints,  I have one. I found it nearly impossible to find an unassembled grill at Home Depot. To get a grill in the box, I had to special order it. When it comes to cooking on the grill, I was impressed. The heat seems to be evenly distributed on the grids; this is impressive. Past grills heated unevenly. The cooking results were fantastic. I highly recommend this grill to anybody that seeks quality and tasty results.
Results.Title: The Best Gas Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Several years ago, I purchased a cheaper (non-Weber) grill, and have had to buy two regulators for it. Also, the ignitor went bad. The last regulator went bad, and that was the last straw.... my next grill was gonna be a Weber. I could smack myself for not getting a Weber a lot sooner! It is much heavier duty, and it cooks a perfect steak and tasty chicken (so far!) Yes, a Weber grill costs more, but it is well worth it!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: It's been years since I've owned a gas grill, having gone back to charcoal....   but all in all, the prep and clean-up became too much to deal with.  I knew that Weber has always had one of the very best reputations and decided to go for it...  a couple of other brands I had from the past didn't fare too well and I didn't want to make the same mistakes again.  With the exception of the wheels which are not heavy duty at all, you can tell the quality is built in to all the parts and components. The ignition system is nifty because you don't get that annoying clicking sound that's the norm, hoping the grill will light.  Kudos for this big improvement  over the old standard!  The directions and parts list are well formatted and easy to follow. The only thing I have to complain about is that not all the screws and washers were included in the heat-sealed "A" bag..  Customer service was friendly and efficient and sent an entire bag which I had in 2 days... however we had to stop with assembly and wait to finish later in the week.  Weber take note...  there is no excuse for this and it makes me wonder how many units went out to other customers so please check  with your quality control department so others don't have to go through this, especially if they're planning to grill later in the day!  Replacements at Home Depot?.. perhaps, but that's not the point.  Except for this issue and the wheels, easily a 5 star product!
Results.Title: You get what you pay for!

Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together.
